sections.h2: Lagomar Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 92 residential sales closed in Lagomar (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $942,500, well above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 14 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Lagomar sales closed between $814,975 and $1,092,500, or about $270 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($1,005,000, 46 sales) was about 10% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($916,000, 46 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Lagomar sales were in ZIP code 23456.

The median Lagomar home is about 3,610 square feet, larger than the 1,706 square foot citywide median. 97% of Lagomar sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. 100% of sales here were detached homes, versus 61% citywide.

sections.h2: When Lagomar Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Lagomar
sections.html:
All of the sales were detached single-family homes. The median home was about 3,610 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 3,089 to 3,949 square feet. 51% of the homes that sold had 5 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1982 and 2014, with a median year built of 1997, so this is a mix of homes from the 1990s to the 2010s.
